claims.claim: MCP server konsumuje tokeny na dwa sposoby: tool definitions (upfront cost) + tool results (per-use cost).
Benchmark: 7 MCP servers active = 67,300 tokens tool definitions (33.7% budzetu 200k).
Multi-server setup typical (GitHub, Slack, Sentry, Grafana, Splunk): ~55k tokens definitions przed first query.
Single middle-size server (np. Slack): ~8k tokens definitions. Large (Apify Actors z 2000+ scrapers): 40k+ tokens.
Per API call overhead: kazdy message = fresh API request z full conversation history + full tool schema. Cost powtarzany kazdym message.
Tool Search Tool (Anthropic native Q1 2026) - deferred loading: Claude widzi tylko names upfront, schemas on-demand.
Tool Search Tool benchmark: classical 51k -> TST 8.5k (46.9% redukcja), preserves 191,300 tokens vs 122,800.
GitHub issue #11364 (Lazy-load MCP tool definitions) - historyczny community ask; Tool Search Tool to formalna odpowiedz Anthropic.
Prompt caching dla tool defs: 10% ceny za cache hit, ALE tokens WCIAZ w 200k budget. Caching pomaga kosztowo ($), nie pojemnosciowo.
Auto-compaction: Claude Code automatycznie summuje history gdy zbliza sie do 80% budzetu. Manual `/compact` dostepny.
Patologiczne tool results: DB query 10k rekordow = ~500k tokens (>budget); fetch large HTML 50k+ tokens; git diff monorepo 100k+ tokens.
Timeout issue #20335: MCP timeout config IGNORED dla Streamable HTTP. Default 60s uzywany zamiast user-configured.
Timeout issue #3033: Analogicznie dla SSE (deprecated). Long-running tool calls cut mid-stream.
Timeout issue #44032: Claude Desktop Windows hardcoded 4-minut silent timeout, affect ALL transports, UI state corruption.
Issue #15945: MCP server cause 16h+ system hang, no timeout detection, 70+ zombie processes, manual termination wymagane.
Default timeouts: stdio ~30s, Streamable HTTP ~60s client-side, Claude Desktop Windows hardcoded 4 minut.
Error code timeouts: -32001 Request timeout (JSON-RPC custom MCP).
Streaming spec supported dla content type text (progressive), image (batch only), resource (reference/leniwe). Claude Code 2026 partial obsluga.
Context budget tabela: 0 servers 0%, 1-2 small 2-5%, 3-5 typical 7-15%, 6-8 power-user 20-30%, 10+ heavy 35-50%, 15+ extreme 50%+.
Recommendation: nie przekraczac 5-7 servers naraz. Claude Code 2026 pozwala /mcp disable + /mcp enable dynamicznie.
Model routing per MCP tool NIE ISTNIEJE 2026-04-17 - cala sesja jeden model. Wyjatek: subagents mogą być configured z innym modelem (osobna mechanika).
Response size hard limits: 200k context window total; zalecany target <5k tokens per tool call; >50k rozwala UX.
Server-side mitigation: pagination (next_cursor), selection (only requested fields), size caps (truncate + warning), pre-summarize w serverze.
Context sandboxing tool (context-mode github.com/mksglu/context-mode) - 98% redukcja przez file sandbox wrapping MCP output.
